Markets.title: Indian rupee FX premiums jump after RBI policy leaves traders bracing for more sell/buy swaps
Markets.summary: Following the Reserve Bank of India's policy meeting, 1-year dollar/rupee forward premiums jumped to a six-month high. This increase was driven by trader expectations of more foreign exchange swaps, while the spot USD/INR rose by 0.28% toward its historical peak.

Markets.title: Global Market: Hedge fund group warns BoE repo reforms could worsen market stress
Markets.summary: The hedge fund group AIMA has warned the Bank of England that its proposed gilt repo reforms could reduce market liquidity. AIMA stated that these changes, which include wider central clearing, might make the financial system more vulnerable to funding disruptions during periods of market stress.

Markets.title: Pine Labs, CAMS, Moneyview, other fintech stocks rally up to 11% after RBI MPC move. Here’s why
Markets.summary: Shares of fintech firms like Pine Labs and Moneyview rose up to 11% following the RBI's announcement of interoperability among NBFC account aggregators. This new policy allows customers to share their financial information across different account aggregators using a single account and consent, eliminating the need for fresh registrations.

Markets.title: Why India could become a global hub for responsible digital assets innovation
Markets.summary: India can become a global hub for responsible digital asset innovation by leveraging its technology talent, blockchain expertise, and digital infrastructure. Combining artificial intelligence and onchain technologies will enable advanced financial tools, while thoughtful regulations will protect consumers and strengthen the country's leadership.

Markets.title: RBI hikes rate, but analysts see shift to ‘calibrated tightening’ as bigger takeaway. How can this impact markets?
Markets.summary: The Reserve Bank of India raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50 percent and signaled that near-term rate cuts are unlikely. This shift is expected to pressure rate-sensitive sectors, while banks with strong balance sheets should remain better positioned.

Markets.title: Trent’s Rs 1.80 lakh crore rout from peak: Has Q2 just flipped the script for Tata group’s retail crown jewel?
Markets.summary: Trent reported a 23% year-over-year revenue increase in Q2FY27 alongside continued store expansions for Zudio and Westside. Despite this strong financial performance, analysts remain divided on the company's future outlook following a massive decline from its peak market value.

Data & Insights.summary: Borrowers with floating-rate loans will see higher monthly payments or longer repayment terms because of the RBI's rate hike. Lenders will quickly pass these revised interest rates on to their customers.

Data & Insights.summary: India's central bank raised its benchmark repo rate for the first time since February 2023 to combat rising inflation. Additionally, the monetary policy committee shifted its policy stance from neutral to calibrated tightening.

Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council is considering a proposal on Thursday to share tax data for official economic statistics beyond traditional tax administration. Additionally, the Council will discuss tax relief measures for rare diseases.

Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council meeting led by Nirmala Sitharaman will consider proposals to make tax compliance easier and reduce frequent rate changes. The meeting will also discuss speeding up business GST registration from over three weeks to three working days.

Data & Insights.title: World Bank raises India FY27 growth forecast to 7.1% on resilient demand, exports
Data & Insights.summary: The World Bank has raised India's fiscal year 2027 economic growth forecast to 7.1%. This upward revision is driven by strong domestic demand, robust exports, resilient industrial activity, and potential productivity gains from artificial intelligence.
